description_en: Translates images using the Pro edition, which is designed specifically for e-commerce images. This product integrates multimodal large model technology to achieve more accurate image understanding, significantly improve translation quality, and continuously expand and optimize multilingual translation capabilities. Supports more than 100 language directions (including bridged translations)
description_zh:
图片翻译Pro版产品专为电商图片设计，融合多模态大模型技术，实现对图片的更精准理解，显著提高翻
译质量，并不断扩展和优化多语言翻译能力。支持100多种(含桥接)语向
kebab_example: aliyun aidge image-translation-pro --source-language en --target-language ko --image-url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i3/O1CN01HTDhDi28Fd85ZYs7H_!!6000000007903-0-tps-800-800.jpg' --including-product-area false --use-image-editor false --translating-brand-in-the-product false --glossary glossary_1 --async true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImageTranslationPro

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to translate text on the image subject. Optional. Default value: false. This helps you protect information and avoid translating embedded information such as product names.
